name: Weapon Spare Ammo
description: Every gun carries {{multiplier}} times as much spare ammo.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Spare ammo multiplier
settings.help: Whole numbers only - these are whole-number columns in the game. 1 leaves it at stock. Capped at x10, well inside a defensible multiple of the highest spare-ammo count the stock game itself ever uses.

patches.sql: UPDATE master_part SET spare = spare * {{multiplier}} WHERE type = 'PTTP_ARM' AND spare > 0;
